scope: Fictional native Compose seed handoff and detached Reader account-target continuity

runtime.releaseBoundary: Not Developer ID signed, notarized, stapled, updater-signed, installed, or published.

passed.result: The first physical CR-injected mailto opened a new Compose child with an opaque seedDbKey and opener=main. The visible To value retained the literal line-break input, Subject was Fictional report, the line-break warning was visible, and Send was disabled. The child and original window were closed without sending.

All eleven physical mailto cases opened the expected Compose state and closed unsent. CR and LF recipient, Cc, and subject cases showed warning plus disabled Send. Double-encoded values remained literal and sendable. The CRLF body case retained a multiline body and remained sendable.

Ten detached Reader open and close cycles rendered the expected fictional account and message body. One cycle was interrupted by the computer-use guard after open; a refreshed state was captured and the window then closed, followed by complete cycles five through ten. This is recorded as an interruption, not a product flake.

A detached Reader for account two rendered its distinct cached body and account-two attachment. Its Reply used Fictional Reader Two as From, preserved the quoted account-two body, and its Forward retained the 39 B account-two attachment. Both Compose children and the Reader closed unsent.

excluded.reason: Despite its filename, Cmd-R was not used. It records a different Reply seed and provider-derived subject, then both windows were closed. It is not reload evidence.

retainedPriorFailure.result: The previous physical blank Compose seed failure remains historical trigger evidence. This replay validates the later token-bound event handoff; it does not erase the earlier failure.

notCoveredByThisReceipt: Native Compose or Reader reload after an accepted handoff.
